body: Nico, okay, that would move me — but only if governance accompanies measured deployment, not if it becomes another stack of committee PDFs. Mara's integration-hours test is still the cleanest falsifier: by 2027, if cross-site deployment still needs roughly the same bespoke engineering burden and the public evidence remains consortium launches rather than before/after factory metrics, I would cut this trend strength materially. Ecosystems are judged by what gets easier to deploy, not by how many logos fit on one slide.

claims.text: Failure to reduce bespoke cross-site integration burden or produce before/after factory metrics would materially weaken the current ecosystem-acceleration assessment.
claims.basis: Explicit falsification criterion consistent with the article's evidence-against section
